messages:
mike: Kicking off POC scoping for Nova (pilot). Need alignment on success criteria, timelines, auth, quotas, streaming vs non-streaming, and eval plan. @jordan do we have their preferred pricing tier?

jordan: Customer prefers usage-based, but wants soft budget cap of $6k/month for the pilot. Wants SLA-ish latency expectations (mobile chat).

emily: Good call. For mobile chat we should push streaming websocket SDK so they get token-by-token UX. If they can't do websockets, fallback to chunked HTTP streaming.

mike: Key success criteria proposal: 1) 95th pct latency < 300ms (streaming tail), 2) response correctness >= 90% on their 200 prompt eval set, 3) avg cost <= $0.38 per 1k tokens. Thoughts?

jordan: Customer will provide the 200 prompts and an automated comparator for correctness (exact match + tolerance). Timeline: 2-week pilot. Week 1: integration + smoke test. Week 2: run evals, tune prompts, handoff.

emily: Integration checklist I shared with SEs: SDK install, auth, sample streaming, retry policy, quotas. I'll paste minimal examples they can drop in.

emily: ```js
// js streaming (conceptual)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-nova-v1', conversation: [] });
stream.on('data', (chunk)=> console.log(chunk.text));
stream.on('end', ()=> console.log('done'));
```

emily: And curl chunked example:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-nova-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

mike: Auth: they want API-key + optional service-account for servers. Confirm KMS integration requirement? Jordan: they asked for KMS/HSM only if we go to Dedicated/Private later. For pilot, API keys fine.

emily: Quotas and rate limits: propose pilot defaults — 120 reqs/minute, 30 concurrent streams, 10k tokens/minute (soft). We'll expose per-route quotas in Console. If they spike, traffic should fallback to non-streaming smaller model.

mike: Retries: use idempotency keys for non-chat endpoints. Backoff policy: 500ms -> 1s -> 2s (max 3 retries) for 5xx and 429 with Retry-After respect. Add client-side circuit-breaker for sustained 5xx.

emily: Example retry header pattern to send from client: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` and `X-RW-Client-Version: se-1.2.0`

jordan: Security questionnaire note: they asked about audit logs and token scoping. We can provide per-key scoping (read-only vs inference) and activity logs for last 90 days on pilot. I'll attach the minimal security excerpt to the SOW.

qa-bot: Reminder: add the 200-prompt eval file to /shared/pilot-evals/Nova when ready.

mike: Eval plan quick: run 200 prompts x 5 seeds (sampling temp 0.0, 0.2, 0.7) collect latency, token usage, correctness. Produce a one-pager with top failure cases and prompt tweaks.

emily: Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prefixes (chat starters) to cut token cost ~25% in our tests.

jordan: Customer asks about billing alerting once they hit 70% of soft cap — we can configure Console alerts + webhook to their ops slack.

mike: Can we get dev-ops to stand up a short-lived Dedicated pool if we need deterministic latency during week 2? @deploy-bot any ETA on spinning a 1-GPU pool for trials?

deploy-bot: Provisioning request received. Estimated ready in ~18 hours (subject to capacity).

emily: Next steps: 1) Jordan to collect 200 prompts + comparator, 2) Emily to send SDK snippets + retry config, 3) Mike to produce success criteria doc and timeline, 4) Jordan to confirm billing alert webhook.

jordan: I'll send the prompts today and confirm budget cap enforcement. :thumbsup:

mike: Great — I'll draft the one-pager and share by EOD tomorrow. Thanks team.
